lines.open: Open session: everyone votes when it suits them
lines.duo: For two: the first shared “works for me” decides

picker.hint: The rules are locked when voting starts. Below 100%, the ranking lands as soon as the threshold is reached: missing ballots count as 0, just like when the vote is closed early.
picker.openHint: Open session: no closing threshold, since you don’t know how many will vote. The deadline closes the vote — or you do, by hand. Missing ballots count as 0.

suggestion.label: Suggested selection
suggestion.title: A selection to get you started
suggestion.summary: {recent, plural, one {A restaurant seen recently} other {Restaurants seen recently}}{winners, plural, =0 {} one {, minus the winner from the last {days} days} other {, minus the # winners from the last {days} days}}{fresh, select, mine { — plus one never suggested before, the last one you added} catalog { — plus one never suggested before, the latest addition to the database} other {}}.
suggestion.editable: You can change all of it.

page.title: Who’s deciding lunch?
page.description: Three steps, then you invite the group to vote.

steps.name: Session name
steps.restaurantsHint: Your lists, the database of places people already know, Google: pick from anywhere and mix them up.
steps.groupsHint: The lunch crew, notified in one click — nobody has to type the code again.

create.groupsNote: Members get a pending invitation. They only count as participants once they’ve joined the session — nobody holds up the vote without being there.
create.submit: Create the session · {count, plural, one {# restaurant} other {# restaurants}}
create.allExcluded: Everything is skipped as a recent winner

antiFatigue.label: Skip recent winners
antiFatigue.recent: {count, plural, one {# restaurant has} other {# restaurants have}} won in the last {days} days.
antiFatigue.excluded: {count, plural, one {# restaurant skipped} other {# restaurants skipped}} for this session.
antiFatigue.none: None of your picks has won recently.

open.label: Open session
open.tagline: · everyone votes when it suits them
open.hintOff: Waiting room: you start the vote once everyone’s there, and nobody else can join after that.
open.hintOn: No waiting room: voting starts straight away, everyone votes when they see the link, until the deadline.

hints.none: With no deadline, the session closes once everyone has voted — or when you close it.
hints.timed: At the set time, the ranking appears: missing votes count as 0. You can extend it before then.
hints.required: Open session: a deadline is required, it’s what closes the vote. Everyone votes until then, and you can extend it.

page.title: Scan or enter the code
page.description: The host shows you their QR code, tells you the code, or sends you the link.

join.notAnInvite: This QR code isn’t an onmangekoi invitation.
join.label: Invitation code or link
join.hint: The 6-character code, or the full link pasted as is. Capitals and dashes are optional.

scanner.denied: Camera access denied. Type the code instead.
scanner.unsupported: No camera available here. Type the code instead.

invite.title: Invitation code
invite.howTo: Say it out loud (capitals and dashes don’t matter), let them scan it, or send it as a link.
invite.qrHint: Everyone else scans this QR code with their phone camera. Tap it to show it full size.
invite.dialogDescription: Point the camera at this code, or use “I have a code” in the app.
invite.shareText: We’re voting on where to eat, it takes two minutes.

invitees.waiting: {count, plural, one {# guest pending} other {# guests pending}}
invitees.note: Send them the link: they only count as participants once they’ve joined the session.
invitees.invited: {count, plural, one {# person from “{group}” is expected.} other {# people from “{group}” are expected.}}

page.title: Deciding for two?
page.description: Pick a few restaurants, send the link. You both swipe the same ones: the first shared “works for me” settles it.

create.title: The restaurants to swipe
create.hint: You’ll both see the same ones, in the same order. A few are enough: it stops at the first shared “works for me”.
create.submit: Let’s go · {count, plural, one {# restaurant} other {# restaurants}}

duo.together: Deciding with {partner}: the first shared “works for me” settles it.
duo.inviteText: No code to read out: the other person opens the link and lands straight on the same restaurants. You can start voting without waiting — the first shared “works for me” settles it.
duo.shareText: Let’s pick where to eat, just the two of us: swipe through the restaurants, and the first shared “works for me” settles it.

openPanel.label: Open session
openPanel.summary: Open until the deadline · {count, plural, one {# participant} other {# participants}}

duo.partnerAbsent: The other person hasn’t opened the link yet. As soon as they say “works for me” to a restaurant you liked, it’s settled.
duo.bothDone: You’ve both finished without a match: the ranking is on its way.
duo.partnerVoting: No match yet. If {partner} says “works for me” to a restaurant you liked, it’s settled; otherwise the ranking lands when they finish their deck.

finished.open: The session stays open until the deadline: others can still join and vote. The ranking will appear when it closes.
finished.everyoneDone: Everyone’s done, the ranking is on its way.
finished.thresholdReached: The closing threshold has been reached, the ranking is on its way.
finished.waitingFor: Waiting for {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}. The ranking will appear automatically.
finished.threshold: Closes once {ratio} of participants are done — that’s {required} out of {total}.
finished.confirmClose: Confirm closing — missing votes count as 0

closeHint.duo: Otherwise, the session closes at the first match, or once you’ve both finished.
closeHint.open: Otherwise, the session closes on its own at the deadline.
closeHint.threshold: Otherwise, the session closes on its own at the chosen threshold.
closeHint.all: Otherwise, the session closes on its own once everyone has voted.

room.firstRound: Breaking the tie from the <link>first round</link>.

announcements.voting: Voting has started: your turn to vote.
announcements.closed: Voting is over, opening the ranking.
announcements.agreed: It’s a match: opening the result.

room.agreedOpening: It’s a match! Opening the result…

hints.both: You need at least {participants} participants and {restaurants} restaurants to start.
hints.participants: You need at least {participants} participants to start.
hints.restaurants: With just one restaurant, there’s nothing to decide: everyone can bring their own.
hints.ready: Once started, nobody else can join.

sessionRestaurants.title: {count, plural, one {# restaurant to choose from} other {# restaurants to choose from}}
sessionRestaurants.label: Session restaurants
sessionRestaurants.add: Add {count, plural, one {# restaurant} other {# restaurants}}

constraints.blocked: {count, plural, one {# participant can’t eat here} other {# participants can’t eat here}}

deck.swipe: Swipe the card right for “works for me”, left for “nah”.

jokers.none: No jokers in this session: only “nah” and “works for me” count.
jokers.superlikes: Jokers count double: {superlikes, plural, one {# favourite} other {# favourites}} for the whole session.
jokers.vetos: Jokers count double: {vetos, plural, one {# veto} other {# vetoes}} for the whole session.
jokers.both: Jokers count double: {superlikes, plural, one {# favourite} other {# favourites}} and {vetos, plural, one {# veto} other {# vetoes}} for the whole session.

deck.keyboardArrows: <key>←</key> and <key>→</key> do “nah” and “works for me”, <key>Enter</key> confirms “works for me”.

eyebrow.agreement: It’s a match · we’re eating at

results.agreementNote: You both said yes: no need to go any further in the deck.
results.overrideNote: Host’s pick: the vote had {leader} in the lead.

tie.draw: Picked by drawing lots, in a dead heat with {others}.
tie.runoff: Dead heat with {others}: the second round is under way.
tie.decided: Chosen by the host, in a dead heat with {others}.

page.description: {participants, plural, one {# participant} other {# participants}} · {restaurants, plural, one {# restaurant} other {# restaurants}}
page.emptyDescription: The session ended without a restaurant.

podium.description: {count, plural, one {# participant had their say} other {# participants had their say}}
podium.cta: This ranking comes from a group vote. Yours takes two minutes, no account needed.

tiebreak.title: Dead heat
tiebreak.runoffText: {names} are going head to head in a new session: same participants, jokers reset.
tiebreak.hostText: {names} finished with the same score and as many favourites. Your call.
tiebreak.guestText: {names} finished with the same score and as many favourites. The host will decide.
tiebreak.confirmRunoff: Confirm — vote again between the tied ones
tiebreak.confirmDraw: Confirm — let chance pick the winner

decision.title: Shall we go?
decision.confirmText: Confirm the place: everyone will see “We’re eating at {name}” instead of just the ranking.
decision.decidedText: Everyone sees “We’re eating at {name}”. Something came up? You can still change it.

sharing.title: Share the results
sharing.publicText: Anyone with the link sees the podium and the number of participants. No nicknames, no vote details.
sharing.privateText: Only the session’s participants can see the ranking.
sharing.closeNote: Turning the link off makes it unreachable straight away, previews included.

launch.done: This browser will let you know when voting starts, even with the tab closed.

results.done: This browser will let you know as soon as the ranking lands, even with the tab closed.

push.denied: Notifications are blocked for onmangekoi: allow them in your browser settings to get the alert.
push.installFirst: On iPhone, notifications go through the app: add onmangekoi to your home screen (Share → Add to Home Screen), then open the session from the app.
push.failed: Couldn’t turn on notifications in this browser. Try again later.

page.title: My sessions
page.description: Where we ate, and what the group had picked.
